label: CONFIRMED: Permanent repairs need separate owners for disk-derived facts, exact template metadata, phrase seeding, structural anchor repair, and missing-document recovery; only unique exact Git history supports automatic restoration of a missing document.

CONFIRMED: Failure prevention belongs at producers and validators: archive path sync, all create-route graph finalization, independent anchor-boundary fixtures, and a version-aware anchor contract address observed sources without imposing current template shape on old documents.

CONFIRMED: The legacy upgrader stops at manual v3 layout moves, while doctor update check is read-only and its release engine is scoped to .skilled; a separate transactional migration with a dry-run plan and before-images is the supported inferred design.

CONFIRMED: Branch hardening should scope the rebuild credential to push, constrain manual refs, check all four generator outputs, unify phrase cleanup and healing defaults, fix phase graph finalization, and make every Gate 3 menu carry the same-track series-parent condition.

CONFIRMED: Cheap staged and changed-packet checks belong in local hooks and PR CI; full-corpus validation stays scheduled/reporting until runtime is measured, and pre-commit graph remint must be described as a mutating derived-metadata step.

direction: Widen repair-derived to edit anchors or authored prose
reason: Path and graph derivation is a deterministic metadata boundary; anchors change document structure, and prose reconstruction can invent content without historical evidence.

direction: Treat markerless documents as current-template documents
reason: Marker absence does not establish template version or historical intent.

direction: Run a full-corpus strict validator in every local pre-commit
reason: No runtime measurement supports the cost, and scheduled corpus reporting already provides fleet-wide visibility.
